description: Complete the Canadian visa application by submitting required documents and meeting eligibility criteria.

requirements.name: Proof of Address
requirements.description: A utility bill or bank statement showing your current address.
requirements.validation_hints: The document must be dated within 3 months of the application date.

requirements.name: Passport
requirements.description: A valid passport with at least six months' validity.
requirements.validation_hints: The passport must be valid for at least six months beyond the intended stay in Canada.

requirements.name: Proof of Funds
requirements.description: A bank statement or proof of income showing sufficient funds for the intended stay.
requirements.validation_hints: The funds must be sufficient to support the applicant's stay in Canada.
